# Afghanistan OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **5 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Afghanistan ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Afghanistan national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Afghanistan public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Afghanistan in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 7,051,000 |
| Lines / route length | 19 / 442 km |
| Fleet | 822 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $4.06 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $3.04 B (75%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 68.8 MW / 388.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $6.29 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
